summary: Wrote a 7-phase plan deriving every gate-count expectation from gate-registry.data instead of integers: a gate_registry_max_id accessor single-sourced with verify-deploy.sh's --only-gate bound, converted assertions in both named suites with paired negative controls, two cross-source drift guards (reported bound == derived max; no-flag header set == derived id set, both directions), and a path-mirrored copied-store fixture that registers a throwaway gate 27 to prove both suites stay green with zero edits. Planning found three further same-class sites the description's 'sole remaining place' framing missed (crash-net seq 1 23 silently under-covering gates 24-26, measure-gate-costs.sh's default gate list, and three stale prose counts), folded into Phase 3. No research artifact existed; the description carried the defect, file inventory and acceptance bar, so Stage 1.5 planned directly rather than requesting research.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan: registry-derived gate-count expectations, two drift guards, fixture-store throwaway-gate proof, full battery plus redeploy.
